name: zinput_bindgroup_list_static_init_and_register_at_exit
description: zInput::BindGroupList_StaticInitAndRegisterAtExit runs bind-group list static initialization then tail-calls the atexit registration helper.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput bootstrap/vector pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x429f10 shows a call to zInput::BindGroupListStaticInit followed by a tail jump to zInput::BindGroupListRegisterAtExit.
The dependency frontier is satisfied by the implemented static initializer, static destructor, and registration helper.

The native smoke verifies the combined wrapper returns success, leaves the global bind-group vector default-initialized, and in a child process registers the atexit destructor before leaving live vector storage for process-exit cleanup.
